translations.heroSideHtml:
Scope covered

  • GDPR, data governance, records of processing activities, DPIAs and evidence.
  • AI compliance and the AI Act: classification of AI use cases, controls and governance.
  • ISO, quality, environment and energy (ISO 9001/14001/50001/27001).
  • Information systems security, DORA, NIS2, business continuity and disaster recovery.

  • Requirements and risk mapping, prioritised action plan and RACI matrix.
  • Compliance dashboard for the executive committee.
  • Audit-ready evidence package and review schedule.
